content:
Course Outline:
- Linear Regression Model and Hypothesis Testing
- Dynamic Regression Models (Forecasting Models)
- Forecasting Evaluation
- What to Forecast? How to Forecast?

The specific contents that will be instructed include:
	Data collection, organization, and basic analysis (e.g.主計總處資料庫, 美國聯準會資料FRED)
	Fundamental statistical and regression concepts (線性迴歸模型複習)
	The formulation and specification of forecasting models (時間序列預測模型, 預測評估)
	Intuition training (預測直覺訓練) (Judgment in forecasting involves analytic and intuitive processes.)
books:
Suggested Reference Book:
1) Hill, R.C., Griffiths, W.E. and Lim, G.C. Principles of Econometrics, fourth edition, John Wiley & Sons, Inc., 2011.
2) P.H. Franses, D. van Dijk, and A. Opschoor, Time Series Models for Business and Economic Forecasting, 2nd edition, Cambridge University Press, 2014.
3) Diebold, F.X. Elements of Forecasting with Economic Applications, , 4th edition, Cengage Learning Pub, 2006.
4) Baumohl, Bernard, The Secret of Economic Indicators: Hidden Clues to Future Economic Trends and Investment Opportunities, third edition, FT Press, 2012.

Free-access Open Textbooks: (advanced level)
Diebold, Francis .X. (2017), Forecasting: in Economics, Business, Finance and Beyond, Department of Economics, University of Pennsylvania.
https://www.sas.upenn.edu/~fdiebold/Textbooks.html

grading_policy:
1) 作業與隨堂測驗 (30%):
2) 出席率(20%) 每次缺課扣10分
3) Forecast Project (total 50%):
Students are required to carry out a forecast project and report the results in a written paper. You can work on an individual project or form a team that is consist of at most two students.
- Project proposal (5%)
- In-class presentation of forecasting result (25%)
- Term paper (20%) 期末書面報告: about 8-15 pages
